title: Tino Chrupalla: Bundesregierung braucht Realismus statt Luftschlösser
summary: AfD federal spokesman Tino Chrupalla criticized the German government's economic optimism and called for immediate spending cuts, tax reductions, and elimination of inefficiencies in social insurance systems in response to the federal government needing up to nine billion euros to support unemployment insurance.
speaker: Tino Chrupalla
original_quote: Am Wirtschaftsstandort Deutschland brennt es lichterloh. Doch statt die Realität endlich anzuerkennen, verbreitet die Bundesregierung weiterhin unberechtigten Optimismus und baut Luftschlösser – ob nun mit Blick auf die wirtschaftlichen Chancen dank KI, die Investitionsbereitschaft internationaler Investoren, die Klimawende oder die Perspektiven der Ukraine.
translation: Germany as a business location is burning fiercely. But instead of finally acknowledging reality, the federal government continues to spread unjustified optimism and builds castles in the air – whether regarding economic opportunities thanks to AI, the investment readiness of international investors, the climate transition, or the prospects of Ukraine.

title: Stillstand inakzeptabel: Wie und mit wem soll es in Regierung weitergehen?
summary: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz criticized the ÖVP-SPÖ coalition government for creating chaos through announced ministerial reshuffles without a clear plan, called on President Van der Bellen to intervene, and demanded rapid new elections with Herbert Kickl ready to assume responsibility.
speaker: Michael Schnedlitz
original_quote: Das Chaos in der SPÖ war anscheinend noch nicht groß genug. Jetzt haben ÖVP und SPÖ gleich auf zwei von drei Seiten dieser Verlierer-Ampel das nächste Chaos losgetreten.
translation: The chaos in the SPÖ was apparently not big enough. Now ÖVP and SPÖ have triggered the next chaos on two of three sides of this loser traffic-light coalition.

title: Stillstand inakzeptabel: Wie und mit wem soll es in Regierung weitergehen?
summary: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz criticized the ÖVP-SPÖ coalition government for creating chaos through announced ministerial reshuffles without a clear plan, called on President Van der Bellen to intervene, and demanded rapid new elections with Herbert Kickl ready to assume responsibility.

original_quote: Der einzige Ausweg aus diesem Chaos sind rasche Neuwahlen. Dann entscheidet wieder die Bevölkerung – und nicht eine Handvoll Parteistrategen hinter verschlossenen Türen. Wir Freiheitlichen sind bereit, mit Herbert Kickl Verantwortung für Österreich zu übernehmen!

title: Impfpflicht: Meinl-Reisinger muss sofort sämtliche Fakten zur Abstimmung offenlegen
summary: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz demands that Foreign Minister Beate Meinl-Reisinger immediately disclose all facts about NEOS's 2022 vote supporting mandatory COVID-19 vaccination, following allegations by NEOS co-founder Veit Dengler that the decision was made against the party's internal majority.
speaker: Michael Schnedlitz
original_quote: Da geht es nicht um irgendeine vergessene Parteisitzung. Die Impfpflicht war ein schwerwiegender Eingriff in die persönliche Freiheit, der bis heute viele Menschen beschäftigt und unfassbaren Schaden angerichtet hat.
translation: This is not about some forgotten party meeting. The mandatory vaccination was a serious infringement on personal freedom that still concerns many people today and has caused unimaginable damage.

title: Impfpflicht: Meinl-Reisinger muss sofort sämtliche Fakten zur Abstimmung offenlegen
summary: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz demands that Foreign Minister Beate Meinl-Reisinger immediately disclose all facts about NEOS's 2022 vote supporting mandatory COVID-19 vaccination, following allegations by NEOS co-founder Veit Dengler that the decision was made against the party's internal majority.

translation: The minister should immediately explain who made which decision when, whether there were votes or resolutions, and how dissenting opinions were handled.

title: Pensionisten zahlen mehr, bekommen weniger: Sozialer Offenbarungseid der Regierung
summary: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz criticized the coalition government for introducing an E-Card fee for pensioners, increasing health insurance contributions, and cutting health services, demanding the reversal of these measures or the government's resignation.
speaker: Michael Schnedlitz
original_quote: Diese Verlierer-Ampel hat beim Sparen anscheinend eine Lieblingsadresse: die Geldbörsen unserer Pensionisten! Zuerst werden ihre Krankenversicherungsbeiträge erhöht, jetzt wird ihnen auch noch die E-Card-Gebühr aufgebrummt. Wer jahrzehntelang gearbeitet und Beiträge bezahlt hat, bekommt von Christian Stocker, Markus Marterbauer und Beate Meinl-Reisinger die nächste Rechnung präsentiert. Das ist keine soziale Politik, das ist Abkassieren bei jenen, die dieses Land aufgebaut haben!
translation: This loser traffic-light coalition apparently has a favorite address when it comes to saving: the wallets of our pensioners! First their health insurance contributions are increased, now they are also burdened with the E-Card fee. Those who have worked for decades and paid contributions are presented with the next bill by Christian Stocker, Markus Marterbauer and Beate Meinl-Reisinger. This is not social policy, this is cashing in on those who built this country!

title: Pensionisten zahlen mehr, bekommen weniger: Sozialer Offenbarungseid der Regierung
summary: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz criticized the coalition government for introducing an E-Card fee for pensioners, increasing health insurance contributions, and cutting health services, demanding the reversal of these measures or the government's resignation.
speaker: Michael Schnedlitz
original_quote: Mehr einzahlen, weniger herausbekommen – das ist das Ergebnis dieser angeblich sozialen Regierung! Dafür hat es anscheinend die SPÖ gebraucht. Wer eine Zahnprothese benötigt, zahlt mehr, und Familien verlieren im Krankheitsfall Unterstützung. Ausgerechnet unter der roten Gesundheitsministerin Korinna Schumann werden Leistungen zusammengestrichen. Die viel beschworene soziale Handschrift der SPÖ ist in Wahrheit ein Griff in die Taschen der Versicherten!
translation: Pay more in, get less out – that is the result of this supposedly social government! Apparently that's what the SPÖ was needed for. Those who need dentures pay more, and families lose support in case of illness. It is precisely under the red Health Minister Korinna Schumann that services are being cut. The much-invoked social signature of the SPÖ is in reality a reach into the pockets of the insured!

title: Pensionisten zahlen mehr, bekommen weniger: Sozialer Offenbarungseid der Regierung
summary: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz criticized the coalition government for introducing an E-Card fee for pensioners, increasing health insurance contributions, and cutting health services, demanding the reversal of these measures or the government's resignation.

original_quote: Wir fordern die Abschaffung der E-Card-Gebühr für Pensionisten und die Rücknahme der Leistungskürzungen. Wenn diese Regierung das nicht schafft, muss sie zurücktreten und den Weg für Neuwahlen freimachen!
translation: We demand the abolition of the E-Card fee for pensioners and the reversal of the service cuts. If this government cannot achieve this, it must resign and make way for new elections!

title: Honkasalo vaatii Helsingin tekoälyn käytölle selkeitä pelisääntöjä valtuustoaloitteella
summary: Left Alliance city councillor and MP Veronika Honkasalo submitted a council initiative on 4 November 2026 demanding that the City of Helsinki investigate how artificial intelligence is used across municipal services and establish clear, democratically processed principles for AI use, including safeguards for data protection, equality, transparency, and citizens' rights to human decision-making.
speaker: Veronika Honkasalo
original_quote: Meidän on tiedettävä, mitä tekoälyllä kaupungin palveluissa tehdään ja millaisia vaikutuksia sillä on ihmisten arkeen. Erityisesti lasten, nuorten ja haavoittuvassa asemassa olevien asiakkaiden kohdalla tarvitaan selkeitä rajoja. Periaatteellista päätöstä tekoälyn hyödyntämisestä ei pidä jättää yksin virkamiesjohdon käsiin, vaan myös luottamushenkilöiden ja kaupunkilaisten on voitava osallistua yhteisten pelisääntöjen määrittelyyn
translation: We must know what is being done with AI in the city's services and what effects it has on people's everyday lives. Especially in the case of children, young people and clients in vulnerable positions, clear boundaries are needed. The principled decision on the use of AI should not be left solely to the civil service management, but elected officials and residents must also be able to participate in defining common rules

title: Honkasalo vaatii Helsingin tekoälyn käytölle selkeitä pelisääntöjä valtuustoaloitteella

speaker: Veronika Honkasalo
original_quote: Tekoäly voi olla hyödyllinen työkalu, mutta vastuun päätöksistä on säilyttävä ihmisellä. Kaupunkilaisilla on oltava oikeus tietää, milloin heidän asioidensa käsittelyssä käytetään tekoälyä
translation: AI can be a useful tool, but responsibility for decisions must remain with humans. Residents must have the right to know when AI is used in processing their matters

translation: We made a unanimous statement in the Education Committee in which national tests are not supported. Now also over 650 education and training researchers have signed a petition opposing standardized tests

title: Pia Lohikoski: Vasemmistoliitto ei kannata tasokokeita perusopetukseen
summary: Left Alliance MP Pia Lohikoski opposes the Audit Committee's proposal for mandatory national standardized tests in basic education, citing unanimous opposition from the Education Committee and over 650 education researchers.

translation: A significant risk in national standardized tests is also that schools will start to be ranked based on them, and segregation will only increase.

title: Pia Lohikoski: Vasemmistoliitto ei kannata tasokokeita perusopetukseen
summary: Left Alliance MP Pia Lohikoski opposes the Audit Committee's proposal for mandatory national standardized tests in basic education, citing unanimous opposition from the Education Committee and over 650 education researchers.

original_quote: Opetus saattaa kaventua, kun kansallisten kokeiden vuoksi keskitytään helposti mitattaviin asioihin. Tässä maailmassa meillä ei todellakaan ole varaa tinkiä laaja-alaisesta opetuksesta ja yleissivistyksestä.
translation: Teaching may narrow when, due to national tests, focus is easily placed on things that are easy to measure. In this world we really cannot afford to compromise on broad-based education and general education.

title: Merja Kyllönen ja Katri Kulmuni: AdBlue-ongelman ratkaisu eteni EU-parlamentissa
summary: Left Alliance MEP Merja Kyllönen and Centre Party MEP Katri Kulmuni secured European Parliament committee support for provisions addressing freezing problems in diesel vehicle AdBlue emission-control systems in cold northern conditions, as part of the Automotive Omnibus regulatory package.
speaker: Merja Kyllönen
original_quote: Suomessa pakkanen kuuluu tavalliseen talveen. Kuljetusyrittäjän tai autoilijan ei pitäisi joutua maksamaan siitä, etteivät ajoneuvon järjestelmät kestä niitä oloja, joissa niitä käytetään. Olemme vaatineet tähän korjausta, ja nyt työ tuottaa tulosta
translation: In Finland, freezing temperatures are part of a normal winter. A transport entrepreneur or motorist should not have to pay for the fact that vehicle systems cannot withstand the conditions in which they are used. We have demanded a correction to this, and now the work is producing results

title: Merja Kyllönen ja Katri Kulmuni: AdBlue-ongelman ratkaisu eteni EU-parlamentissa
summary: Left Alliance MEP Merja Kyllönen and Centre Party MEP Katri Kulmuni secured European Parliament committee support for provisions addressing freezing problems in diesel vehicle AdBlue emission-control systems in cold northern conditions, as part of the Automotive Omnibus regulatory package.
speaker: Katri Kulmuni
original_quote: Pohjoisen ongelman saaminen mukaan laajaan eurooppalaiseen lakipakettiin ei ole ollut itsestään selvää. Suomalainen sisu on tullut tarpeeseen, mutta ennen kaikkea tulos on syntynyt yhteistyöstä yli puoluerajojen ja alan toimijoilta saadusta tuesta
translation: Getting the northern problem included in a broad European legislative package has not been self-evident. Finnish determination has been needed, but above all the result has come from cooperation across party lines and support from industry actors

title: Merja Kyllönen ja Katri Kulmuni: AdBlue-ongelman ratkaisu eteni EU-parlamentissa
summary: Left Alliance MEP Merja Kyllönen and Centre Party MEP Katri Kulmuni secured European Parliament committee support for provisions addressing freezing problems in diesel vehicle AdBlue emission-control systems in cold northern conditions, as part of the Automotive Omnibus regulatory package.
speaker: Katri Kulmuni
original_quote: Päästövähennystavoitteista pidetään kiinni, mutta keinojen on toimittava myös pohjoisen pakkasissa. Sääntelyn pitää mahdollistaa ratkaisut, joilla päästöt vähenevät ja kalusto toimii luotettavasti ympäri vuoden
translation: Emission reduction targets are being maintained, but the means must also work in northern freezing conditions. Regulation must enable solutions where emissions decrease and equipment operates reliably year-round

title: Merja Kyllönen ja Katri Kulmuni: AdBlue-ongelman ratkaisu eteni EU-parlamentissa
summary: Left Alliance MEP Merja Kyllönen and Centre Party MEP Katri Kulmuni secured European Parliament committee support for provisions addressing freezing problems in diesel vehicle AdBlue emission-control systems in cold northern conditions, as part of the Automotive Omnibus regulatory package.

original_quote: Nyt Suomen hallituksen, ministerien ja virkamiesten on huolehdittava siitä, että pohjoisen olosuhteet saavat tuen myös neuvostossa. Olemme saaneet parlamentissa tärkeän askeleen eteenpäin. Seuraavaksi on varmistettava, että tämä työ johtaa suomalaisten ihmisten ja yritysten arjessa toimivaan ratkaisuun
translation: Now the Finnish government, ministers and officials must ensure that northern conditions receive support also in the Council. We have achieved an important step forward in Parliament. Next it must be ensured that this work leads to a solution that works in the everyday lives of Finnish people and businesses

title: Timo Furuholm: Keinoja köyhyyskriisin ratkaisemiseksi kyllä löytyisi
summary: Left Alliance MP Timo Furuholm delivered a group speech in parliament during debate on an opposition interpellation concerning the cost of living, criticizing the right-wing government for worsening poverty and proposing measures including restoring social security protections, child supplements to unemployment benefits, full index increases to benefits, restarting social housing production, and establishing a national crisis mechanism to support low-income people.
speaker: Timo Furuholm
original_quote: Ministeri Purra lupasi, että pienituloisilta leikkaaminen ei perussuomalaisille käy. Sen jälkeen pienituloisilta on leikattu jokaisessa budjetissa. Ei tullut euron bensaa. Ei tullut 100 000 uutta työpaikkaa. Ei lopetettu velaksi elämistä. Sen sijaan saatiin työttömyys- ja köyhyyskriisi.
translation: Minister Purra promised that cutting from low-income people would not be acceptable to the Finns Party. After that, low-income people have been cut in every budget. There was no one-euro gasoline. There were no 100,000 new jobs. Living on debt was not stopped. Instead, we got an unemployment and poverty crisis.

title: Timo Furuholm: Keinoja köyhyyskriisin ratkaisemiseksi kyllä löytyisi
summary: Left Alliance MP Timo Furuholm delivered a group speech in parliament during debate on an opposition interpellation concerning the cost of living, criticizing the right-wing government for worsening poverty and proposing measures including restoring social security protections, child supplements to unemployment benefits, full index increases to benefits, restarting social housing production, and establishing a national crisis mechanism to support low-income people.
speaker: Timo Furuholm
original_quote: Vasemmistoliitto palauttaisi suojaosat sosiaaliturvaan, lapsikorotuksen työttömyysturvaan ja toteuttaisi indeksikorotukset etuuksiin täysimääräisesti. Myös alas ajettu sosiaalinen asuntotuotanto pitäisi potkaista jälleen käyntiin, jotta ihmisillä olisi tulevaisuudessakin kohtuuhintaisia koteja.
translation: The Left Alliance would restore protected portions to social security, child supplements to unemployment benefits, and implement index increases to benefits in full. The run-down social housing production should also be kicked back into action so that people would have affordable homes in the future as well.

title: Timo Furuholm: Keinoja köyhyyskriisin ratkaisemiseksi kyllä löytyisi
summary: Left Alliance MP Timo Furuholm delivered a group speech in parliament during debate on an opposition interpellation concerning the cost of living, criticizing the right-wing government for worsening poverty and proposing measures including restoring social security protections, child supplements to unemployment benefits, full index increases to benefits, restarting social housing production, and establishing a national crisis mechanism to support low-income people.
speaker: Timo Furuholm
original_quote: Me vasemmistoliitossa emme vaadi mahdottomia. Me vaadimme politiikkaa, jolla pidetään kaikki ihmiset mukana. Politiikkaa, joka palvelee tavallisia suomalaisia, ei vain miljonäärejä. Politiikan tehtävä on turvata ihmisarvoinen elämä kaikille – ei vain harvoille.
translation: We in the Left Alliance do not demand the impossible. We demand politics that keeps all people included. Politics that serves ordinary Finns, not just millionaires. The task of politics is to secure a dignified life for everyone – not just for the few.

title: Islam: da Monfalcone FdI rilancia sfida a velo integrale e separatismo
summary: Brothers of Italy announces a legislative proposal requiring transparency on mosque financing, banning full-face veils, increasing penalties for arranged marriages, and prohibiting virginity certificates, while criticizing left-wing parties for allegedly allying with Islamism.
actors: Lucio Malan; Galeazzo Bignami; Sara Kelany; Francesco Filini; Giorgia Meloni
speaker: Lucio Malan
original_quote: L'integrazione richiede il rispetto delle nostre regole, mentre in diversi Paesi europei fino al 64% dei musulmani ritiene che la sharia venga prima delle leggi dello Stato
translation: Integration requires respect for our rules, while in various European countries up to 64% of Muslims believe that sharia comes before state laws

title: Islam: da Monfalcone FdI rilancia sfida a velo integrale e separatismo
summary: Brothers of Italy announces a legislative proposal requiring transparency on mosque financing, banning full-face veils, increasing penalties for arranged marriages, and prohibiting virginity certificates, while criticizing left-wing parties for allegedly allying with Islamism.
actors: Lucio Malan; Galeazzo Bignami; Sara Kelany; Francesco Filini; Giorgia Meloni
speaker: Galeazzo Bignami
original_quote: Chi sceglie di vivere nella nostra nazione è tenuto ad accettarne fino in fondo le regole e i principi costituzionali, sottoscrivendo le intese previste dall'articolo 8 della Costituzione e garantendo piena trasparenza su chi finanzia le moschee
translation: Those who choose to live in our nation are required to fully accept its rules and constitutional principles, subscribing to the agreements provided by Article 8 of the Constitution and guaranteeing full transparency on who finances mosques

title: Islam: da Monfalcone FdI rilancia sfida a velo integrale e separatismo
summary: Brothers of Italy announces a legislative proposal requiring transparency on mosque financing, banning full-face veils, increasing penalties for arranged marriages, and prohibiting virginity certificates, while criticizing left-wing parties for allegedly allying with Islamism.
actors: Lucio Malan; Galeazzo Bignami; Sara Kelany; Francesco Filini; Giorgia Meloni
speaker: Sara Kelany
original_quote: Con la nostra proposta di legge contrastiamo le sacche di separatismo religioso e le 'no-go zone' in cui vige la Sharia, introducendo l'obbligo di trasparenza sui finanziamenti esteri alle moschee con la chiusura dei centri non a norma, l'aumento delle pene per i matrimoni combinati e il reato che vieta i certificati di verginità
translation: With our legislative proposal we combat pockets of religious separatism and 'no-go zones' where Sharia prevails, introducing the obligation of transparency on foreign financing to mosques with the closure of non-compliant centers, increased penalties for arranged marriages and the crime that prohibits virginity certificates

title: Islam: da Monfalcone FdI rilancia sfida a velo integrale e separatismo
summary: Brothers of Italy announces a legislative proposal requiring transparency on mosque financing, banning full-face veils, increasing penalties for arranged marriages, and prohibiting virginity certificates, while criticizing left-wing parties for allegedly allying with Islamism.
actors: Lucio Malan; Galeazzo Bignami; Sara Kelany; Francesco Filini; Giorgia Meloni
speaker: Francesco Filini
original_quote: Se in alcuni Paesi islamici alle donne è vietato uscire scoperte, in Italia non sarà consentito circolare a volto coperto, né tollereremo più scene come quelle che si vedono anche a Monfalcone, con le donne costrette a camminare dietro agli uomini
translation: If in some Islamic countries women are forbidden to go out uncovered, in Italy it will not be permitted to circulate with a covered face, nor will we tolerate scenes like those seen also in Monfalcone, with women forced to walk behind men

title: Diritti: tutela disabilità entra con più forza in costituzione
summary: Brothers of Italy senators announced the Senate's unanimous first-reading approval of the Guidi bill amending Article 38 of the Italian Constitution to replace the term 'minorati' with 'persone con disabilità' and guarantee rights to autonomy and participation for people with disabilities.
speaker: Andrea De Priamo
original_quote: Con il ddl Guidi, approvato oggi in prima lettura al Senato con voto unanime, compiamo un passo importante verso il riconoscimento dei diritti delle persone con disabilità nella nostra Costituzione.

translation: We move beyond the term 'minorati', now anachronistic and negatively connoted, to recognize the right to autonomy and effective participation in the political, economic and social life of the country.

title: Diritti: tutela disabilità entra con più forza in costituzione

translation: The cyberattacks that are currently hitting infrastructure and productive activities in several European countries, including Italy, demonstrate how much cybersecurity is now an integral part of our national security. summary: Socialist Left Party working group led by Andreas Sjalg Unneland presents policy document "Green and Fair Local Communities" proposing free kindergarten, expanded municipal housing role, and zero-vision for development of valuable nature ahead of 2027 municipal elections.

original_quote: Vi skal kunne sette et tydelig SV-stempel på Kommune-Norge. Det skal bety noe for folk at SV sitter med makten. Vi vil ha kommuner som reduserer forskjeller, bygger ut velferden og tar vare på naturen.
translation: We shall be able to put a clear SV stamp on Municipal Norway. It shall mean something for people that SV holds power. We want municipalities that reduce differences, expand welfare and take care of nature.

title: SV vil sette et rødt og grønt stempel på Kommune-Norge

original_quote: Vi har gratis skole fordi vi mener alle barn skal ha de samme mulighetene, uavhengig av foreldrenes lommebok. Nå er tiden inne for å ta neste steg og gjøre barnehagen gratis.
translation: We have free school because we believe all children shall have the same opportunities, regardless of their parents' wallet. Now the time has come to take the next step and make kindergarten free.

title: SV vil sette et rødt og grønt stempel på Kommune-Norge

original_quote: Et trygt sted å bo er helt grunnleggende for å kunne leve et godt liv. Likevel har bolig i altfor stor grad blitt noe folk skal tjene penger på, framfor et hjem. Kommunene må igjen bli en aktiv aktør i boligpolitikken.
translation: A safe place to live is completely fundamental to being able to live a good life. Nevertheless, housing has to too great an extent become something people shall earn money from, rather than a home. Municipalities must again become an active actor in housing policy.

title: SV vil sette et rødt og grønt stempel på Kommune-Norge

original_quote: Vi kan ikke fortsette å bygge ned naturen bit for bit og tro at summen ikke betyr noe. Kommunene trenger både tydeligere nasjonale rammer og bedre verktøy for å ta vare på naturen.
translation: We cannot continue to develop nature bit by bit and believe that the sum does not matter. Municipalities need both clearer national frameworks and better tools to take care of nature.

translation: We live in a time of growing inequality, a more turbulent world and a climate and nature crisis with already enormous consequences. In recent years, everyday life has become tougher for many of us. Politics must show that it is possible to give people a better and safer everyday life. We do that with our alternative budget.

title: SVs alternative budsjett: – En vanlig jobb skal være nok til å leve gode liv

translation: This is a dramatic development that affects everyone who lives in a rented home. Today, one in three tenants are financially insecure. Now we are taking major steps to create a new rental sector in Norway that will create predictability and lower prices for people

title: SVs alternative budsjett: – En vanlig jobb skal være nok til å leve gode liv

translation: It has never been more urgent to cut greenhouse gas emissions and take care of nature. Therefore, it is incomprehensible that the government, at a time when we need it more than ever, proposed major cuts in climate measures in its budget proposal.
